tasks.title: audio.elastic command, capability and fake engine
tasks.brief: ADR-0136 is already written; keep it in sync, do not edit brain/INDEX.md (the index line is already there). New header contracts/api/include/sonora/api/elastic.h: ElasticRequest {region, algorithm (polyphonic|rhythmic|monophonic|varispeed), mode ratio=R | warp=SRC:DST,... | quantize=GRID[:STRENGTH]}, parse/format functions with `why`, kCapabilityElastic="audio.elastic", limits kMaxElasticFrames, ratio range 0.25..4, validation (strictly increasing markers, inside the region). tasks.title: common/stretch: warp map, quantize planner, Stretcher interface and fake
tasks.brief: New pure module common/stretch (own CMakeLists, standard C++17, no Rubber Band here): WarpMap (validated SRC->DST markers, output length, inverse lookup), quantize_plan(onsets, MusicalMap/grid, strength 0..100) -> WarpMap with never-crossing markers and refusal reasons (no onsets, bad grid, strength 0), interface Stretcher {process(planar input, WarpMap, algorithm) -> planar output} and a deterministic linear-resample fake used by tests. Pure, off the audio thread. The root CMakeLists.txt is yours alone: add add_subdirectory(common/stretch) after common/model, add add_subdirectory(engine/elastic) guarded by if(EXISTS) after engine/control, and inside the Qt block add_subdirectory(ui/elastic) guarded by if(EXISTS), so the engine and ui tasks do not edit shared CMake files. Tests (label model): marker validation, output length equals the target span, onset quantize on even/swung/sparse onsets, strength 0/50/100, markers never cross, refusals.
accept: tools/micro-build.sh builds common/stretch and its tests pass
no dependency outside the standard library and common/model (tools/module-deps.allow updated if needed)

tasks.title: Engine: audio.elastic job, Rubber Band adapter, one Compound, capability
tasks.brief: New module engine/elastic (own CMakeLists, added by the root line from the stretch task; target_sources on sonora_control with absolute paths; do NOT edit engine/control/CMakeLists.txt, claimed by ui.mixer.sidechain). Rubber Band adapter implementing common/stretch's Stretcher: pkg-config rubberband, offline mode, key-frame map from the WarpMap, algorithm -> options (rhythmic = crisp transients, monophonic = formant preserved, varispeed = plain resample without the library). If rubberband is absent the adapter is not built and the capability is not advertised. Job on the control thread (pattern of sample_edit.cpp and the stems/render jobs): reads the region span plus handles, runs the stretcher, writes Audio Files/<track>_elastic_NN.wav exclusive create and synced, deletes a partial file on cancel or failure, refuses when the result would overlap the next region, then submits ONE Compound (AddSource, SetRegionSources, region length) so undo is one step and the original file is untouched; progress and cancel as the render job. Quantize mode reads onsets through an injected OnsetSource and the tempo map. Registration: one call install_elastic_commands(...) from engine_control_server.cpp (precedent install_stems_commands). Tests (label engine) with the fake Stretcher: one undo step, original file byte-identical, overlap refused, cancel removes the partial file, capability absent without the library, take-open refusal; one adapter test when rubberband is present asserting output length equals the target span.
accept: tools/micro-build.sh builds the engine/control targets reached; ctest -L engine incl. the elastic tests passes
original take file unchanged after apply and after undo; no audio-thread code touched
